description: stocky bearded Three Kingdoms infantryman seen strictly from the front, black and red armor, red headband, one dark spear with one silver wavy blade and one gold butt cap

Right hand holds the same single upright spear with butt grounded. Keep head and torso proportions fixed throughout. No elongation of chest, neck, waist or limbs at any time. Ease back to the exact original neutral silhouette, same armor, shape, scale and colors. Follow the supplied rig and headband and cloth lag. Transparent background, no effects. Keep the original eyes open, eyebrows, face width and beard. At the shout peak only (poses 6–7), briefly open the mouth modestly as if giving a loud shout; close by pose 9. No grin, blink, oversized mouth, enlarged jaw, new teeth or whole-face redesign.
